from collections import Counter
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_dividers = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_dividers = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in row_dividers] + [grid[0][c] for c in col_dividers]
    divider_color = Counter(divider_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if r not in row_dividers]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if c not in col_dividers]
    def runs(indices):
        out = []
        for i in indices:
            if not out or i != out[-1][-1] + 1:
                out.append([i])
            else:
                out[-1].append(i)
        return out
    row_groups, col_groups = runs(rows), runs(cols)
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols if grid[r][c] != divider_color)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(color for color in counts if color != background)
    result = [[background for _ in col_groups] for _ in row_groups]
    for i, rg in enumerate(row_groups):
        for j, cg in enumerate(col_groups):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in rg for c in cg)
            if n > 1:
                result[i][j] = 1
    return result
'''
